question: Does one corrective imitation iteration on states reached by the first student's own full-turn replies improve autonomous searched-response fidelity, after its teacher-forced plan agreement improved but the autonomous gate failed?
arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two-player, native root beam256/slate8/opponent whole-turn beam64, sample round modulo8 zero, action limit2400
frozen_baselines: Routed-v6 direct expert SHA256 68549a5af87e4d2d065a164e39bc515c2c1d48276f437494d757e25c3ef28867; first searched-action student head SHA256 b92e0e9739f44728ee1724ad36dc248b41d4d2a9b258925544eb3c78043865b5. These stay frozen for data collection and comparison.

map_windows.disjointness: All windows are distinct from old searched-action fit6346000, teacher-forced validation6347000, failed autonomous probe6348000, all earlier diagnostics, and untouched final complete-game seed6300000. Do not inspect confirmation or final seeds if validation fails.

corrective_labels: Generate fresh native reply-search self-play root candidate states. From each nonterminal candidate, let the frozen first student choose its own argmax actions until the opponent turn ends or24 actions. At each visited pre-action state, query native whole-turn beam64 search for the next legal action from that exact state. Export that observation, serialized rules and local legal-action label, preserving candidate/map provenance; never substitute the teacher action in the student's rollout. Validate native legality, root candidate replay and censoring. These are replanned corrective actions on student-visited states, not terminal outcomes or an online oracle.
training: Initialize from the frozen first student. Freeze the spatial/rule/value encoder; train only existing action_head and action_residual. Combine old searched-action fit6346000/64 and new corrective-fit6350000/64 maps without validation labels, equally weight independent maps, then sampled positions and their decisions. Use searched-action cross-entropy plus0.2 KL(frozen routed-v6 source || student), AdamW learning rate0.0001 weight decay0.01, gradient clip1.0, deterministic map shuffle seed6350000, exactly2 epochs, no checkpoint or threshold selection. Save one final small action-head checkpoint.
validation: On fresh32 maps seed6351000, compare source, frozen first student and corrective student on exactly the same verified root candidate states. Each executes its own autonomous argmax full opponent reply; no native search is used at inference. Measure absolute asinh(root-perspective native position_score/1000) error versus exact searched opponent response, per map and root seat, response censoring, complete-turn action counts, and selected-root-turn agreement with native reply search. Teacher-forced action and whole-plan metrics are secondary diagnostics only.
validation_gate: Advance only if corrective student has lower per-map mean transformed autonomous successor-score error than the first student on a strict majority of informative independent maps with exact two-sided sign p<0.05, neither root-seat aggregate error increases, censoring does not increase, and native selected-root-turn agreement does not fall. Also report comparison with frozen source. No threshold retuning or intermediate checkpoint choice on validation maps.
confirmation_and_promotion: Only after the validation gate passes, repeat the frozen autonomous comparison on the disjoint64-map confirmation window with the same criteria. This still is not Elo or game strength. Promotion additionally requires fresh complete BOTH-seat matched independent-map games against direct source and native reply-search teacher, runtime/profile checks, then honest pool-relative Elo. Keep reserved final game seed6300000 untouched until these earlier gates pass.
resource_limit: Heavy compute only via SSH server after aggregate resource check, one nice19 CPU process at a time, no GPU, no parallel job or interference with other user workloads. Bound each collection to30 minutes, training to30 minutes and each validation to30 minutes; keep gzipped outputs under100MB total and checkpoints under30MB. Stop and report if limits or completeness fail.
